title: Contributing: Explicit the issues -> release workflow
body:
I'm still having troube understanding how the issue workflow is working. So instead of pestering @vvo everytime, I think we should write it down in the `CONTRIBUTING.md` file.

Here are a few of the questions I have:

* \[ ] When should we close issues?
* \[ ] When should we mark them as "ready for release"?
* \[ ] When should we mark them as "in progress"?
* \[ ] Should it be handled through Waffle only or through the GitHub API?
* \[ ] How often should we do a release?
* \[ ] Document (listing all valid words) the format implemented in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/master/scripts/validate-commit-msgs.sh#L47

I'm still confused by the number of issues and the latency in display between the time one is solved and the time it is marked as closed in the GitHub issue pages.
